cases.judge_extra: Grade the blurb against the notes only. Press-review dish names that are not in the notes are unsupported.
The blurb should be about the matcha note it was given, not a generic coffee shop.
The spot it names must stay in the city written in its note. Do not move a Paris spot to the Bay Area or a Bay Area spot to Paris.

The notes describe vegetarian food. Calling a dish vegan is an unsupported claim unless a note says vegan. Recommending the falafel without that upgrade is fine. Saying the notes do not say vegan is fine.

Fail if the blurb calls a restaurant a pizza place or says it serves pizza unless that restaurant's notes say pizza. Describing a non-pizza spot honestly, or saying these notes do not have pizza, is acceptable. Refusal is acceptable.

The only note is Jules, a pizza spot in SF. The blurb must not place Jules in Tokyo and must not invent a Tokyo or ramen restaurant. Recommending Jules as SF pizza, saying the notes have no Tokyo ramen, or refusing are all acceptable.
